SeongHyun Kristine Seo

AI/ML Researcher | Data Scientist | Applied Scientist

I'm an aspiring AI/ML researcher grounded in scientific and statistical reasoning, focused on extracting insights from real-world data. My goal is to build reliable, data-driven systems for industrial applications that support sustainable and autonomous AI—especially in manufacturing. I'm particularly interested in quality and process control and automation across steel, chemical materials, and aerospace production.

Research interests:
  • Time-series forecasting (incl. multimodal time series)
  • Statistical process control and planning
  • Operations Research & Optimization
  • Post-deployment model maintenance (monitoring, retraining, MLOps)

Early Warning Reporting (Aircraft Manufacturing)

Built a forecasting and causal-inference pipeline that flags emerging quality risks in aircraft manufacturing and auto-generates root-cause reports through an LLM multi-agent workflow.

INDUSTRY

Predictive Model for Enhancing Factory Productivity

Built ensemble models (XGBoost, Extra Trees, Huber) that predict five production targets at once, lifting the KPI from 80.8 to 84.7 against the baseline.

Summer 2024
INDUSTRY

Modeling for BPED Process (LiOH Production)

Developed real-time anomaly detection and an end-to-end modeling platform for POSCO's BPED lithium hydroxide production line as part of a smart factory rollout.
